institution: Yeshiva University College of Dental Medicine
otherConditions: Minimum of 90 semester hours (three full years) of acceptable work from an accredited college or university required. DAT scores required. As a newer dental school, admissions requirements may continue to evolve; applicants should monitor official announcements.

institution: University of Mississippi School of Dentistry
otherConditions: Minimum 90 semester hours required at a fully accredited US or Canadian institution. No specific major required, though strong preference given to applicants completing a baccalaureate degree before entry. Courses taken by correspondence or online, physical/military science, dogmatic religion, and non-major BCPM courses are not accepted.

institution: Harvard University School of Dental Medicine
otherConditions: Prerequisites must be completed prior to matriculation (generally early August). Science courses strongly encouraged to be taken for a letter grade. On-site/in-person coursework strongly preferred; laboratory science requirements should not be taken online. AP credit cannot be used to satisfy the Biology requirement directly, but upper-level Biology courses may satisfy it if AP credit was earned.

courses.name: Biology
courses.details: One year (two semesters) covering cellular and molecular aspects; upper-level biology courses may also satisfy this requirement.

courses.name: Chemistry
courses.details: Two-year sequence covering inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, and biochemistry, including foundational physical/inorganic chemistry topics (bonding, molecular structure, reactivity, equilibrium, energetics, thermodynamics).

courses.name: Physics
courses.details: One year, covering mechanics, kinetics, thermodynamics, properties of matter/quantum theory, wave theory, electricity and magnetism, and optics.
